audience: landlords, owners and property managers who run rentals in Delfi PMS

useCases.title: Find leases that end soon
useCases.text: List the properties, then list the leases with their rent, dates and payment frequency. Open one lease to read its unit.

useCases.title: Review payments and invoices
useCases.text: List payments by property, unit or tenant, with amounts, dates and status. List invoices with their line items.

useCases.title: Check the expenses of a unit
useCases.text: List the expenses of one unit, with amounts, tax, due and payment dates and the supplier. Use the property expenses for the whole property.

useCases.title: Track maintenance requests
useCases.text: List maintenance requests with their status, priority, property and unit. Open one request to read its description and images.

useCases.title: Find the tenant or owner of a unit
useCases.text: List the tenants and owners with the properties and units they rent or own. Open one record for its contact details. The records hold personal contact details.
